title: All edit models: sample only the masked region (crop-stitch) to speed up edits
description:
Every edit model currently samples the WHOLE frame even when the user masks a small region. Cropping to the masked region, sampling that, and stitching back is faster and loses nothing outside the mask. Proven twice on the bench: the user did it on Qwen, and MPI-353 did it on Klein (InpaintCropImproved -> sample -> InpaintStitchImproved, mask_blend_pixels=32, expand=8) where it ALSO cut the seam gradient 6x (14.56 -> 2.44) for ~4s.

This is a MODEL-GRAPH change (make it the standard shape for edit workflows), NOT a new user-facing feature. Distinct from MPI-347, which is the 4K/8K localized-edit APP - that card owns the product outcome, this one owns the shared graph pattern.

SCOPE: sweep every edit-capable model (qwen-edit, krea2 edit, boogu-edit, klein once MPI-354 lands, head-swap app graph). Each is a separate graph, so this is a per-model edit, not one shared fix.

KNOWN TRAPS (inherit from MPI-347's brief before starting):
- the crop-stitch tone-patch trap and its root cause are documented on MPI-347
- app_head_swap.json already uses the inpaint classes but NOTHING on the qwen-edit path declares the custom-node pack as a dep. Fix the declaration as part of this work or it breaks on a clean install.
- crop-stitch is RIGHT when the region is surrounded; ImageCompositeMasked full-frame is still needed where the generation must see the whole scene.
acceptance: Per-model decision recorded: which edit graphs get crop-stitch and which must stay full-frame
Custom-node pack declared as a dep on every path that uses the inpaint classes
Measured before/after time on at least two models
No seam regression - check the stitch gradient, not just wall-clock
